---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm frustrated when …")

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context

Screenshots, links, or references that help explain the idea.

## Scope check

This project intentionally stays minimal. Does this feature belong in core, or could it live as a user-side customization / a separate package?
